findings.summary: The executeBatch catch block unconditionally sets disposition='failure' on all attempts, improperly overwriting the success state of already-processed comments if a subsequent comment throws an exception post-push.
findings.suggested_fix: In the catch block of executeBatch, conditionally update attempts (e.g., skip updating if a.disposition === 'success') to ensure per-comment independence when a post-push exception occurs.

findings.summary: executeBatch redundantly verifies the build and LLM code changes twice for fixed comments: once atomically before push, and then again inside verifyComment, causing severe performance degradation.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor verifyComment's interface to support skipping mechanical build and code checks when executeBatch has already verified them pre-push.
